document: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2017

clauses.title: Mandatory Declarations on E-Commerce Marketplace Platforms
clauses.text: An e-commerce entity shall ensure that mandatory declarations required under Rule 6(1) are displayed on the digital and electronic network used for e-commerce transactions, except the month and year of manufacturing or packing.
clauses.evidence_text: An e-commerce entity shall ensure that the mandatory declarations specified in sub-rule (1) of rule 6 shall be displayed on the digital and electronic network used for e-commerce transactions.

clauses.title: Minimum Height of Numerals and Letters
clauses.text: The height of any numeral and letter in the declaration on the principal display panel shall not be less than 1 mm when the area of principal display panel is up to 50 cm2, and shall scale proportionately for larger panel areas.
clauses.evidence_text: The height of any numeral and letter in the declaration on the principal display panel shall not be less than 1 mm, 2 mm, 4 mm or 6 mm depending on the area of the principal display panel.

clauses.title: Consumer Care Details Mandatory Fields
clauses.text: Name, address, telephone number and e-mail address of the person who or the office which can be contacted in case of consumer complaints must be clearly declared on every package.
clauses.evidence_text: Every package shall bear the name, address, telephone number and e-mail address of the person who or office which can be contacted in case of consumer complaints.
